annotations.title: Finish the X link with your posted nonce

description: Finish a headless X link: give the id or link of the post carrying the nonce from x_link_start. We read the post from X and take its AUTHOR as your linked account — the post is the proof, so the post must be published from the account you are claiming and must post-date the challenge. On success your X handle is stamped on your page (the promoter roster requires it). Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.

post.description: The post id, or its full x.com link
